unreachable_disposition: All unreachable checks are solver-proven infeasible paths, not defects: assumption-pruned branches (check_assume_prunes_branch) and dead panic/overflow paths inside library code (e.g. const-table indexing in char::is_control, shift glue in the bit-ops harness, swap/panic paths in the sorting network). Verification reports 0 failed checks on every harness.

warnings.disposition: Stable rustc emits this for the register_tool attribute that kani-compiler injects to register the kani tool namespace; it appears on every consumer compile with the qualified stable toolchain and is not a consumer-code defect.

unsupported_constructs.disposition: core::panic::Location::caller in core::panicking glue, present only on panic paths; the corresponding unsupported_construct check is SUCCESS (proven unreachable) in every harness where the construct appears.

core::panicking::panic_nounwind_fmt runtime call (rust_begin_unwind), present only on panic paths; the corresponding unsupported_construct check is SUCCESS (proven unreachable) in every harness where the construct appears.
